critical_code_review_comments: sale_mode.py POST /admin/sale-mode/banner accepts `field` as a query parameter (FastAPI default). Frontend passes it as query — works. Consider explicit Query(...) annotation for clarity.

LocationPill.js calls Google Places REST API directly from the browser, exposing REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (unavoidable for JS use but ensure HTTP referrer restrictions are set on the Google Cloud key).
saleMode.js in-memory cache has no TTL; admin toggle changes won't propagate to already-mounted components until next full reload — acceptable for this feature but worth documenting.
